title: VayuSetu Air Quality Episode Event
description: Open schema for a pollution episode: what was observed, why it happened, and who should act. One city publishes this; another city, a state dashboard or a third-party app consumes it without knowing anything about the publisher's models.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the episode event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the observed hour

observed_pm25.description: Measured PM2.5 at this location in ug/m3. An observation, not an estimate.

aqi_band.description: CPCB National AQI band for observed_pm25

n_stations_reporting.description: How many stations contributed to the city aggregate for this hour

population_exposed.description: Estimated population living within the grid cell

attribution.description: Why the episode happened. The drivers are measured; the narrative is generated from them and must cite them.

cause.description: One sentence naming the dominant driver

narrative.description: Human-readable explanation an official can act on

evidence_cited.description: Dotted paths into drivers/ that the narrative relies on. A narrative citing nothing is not publishable.

caveats.description: Known gaps, including every field the publisher could not measure

drivers.description: The measured quantities behind the attribution. A consumer can re-derive the conclusion from these.

upwind_fire_count.description: Fire detections inside the upwind sector in the preceding window

upwind_sector_deg.description: Half-angle of the upwind cone in degrees. This is a wind-sector cone, NOT back-trajectory modelling.

total_frp_mw.description: Summed fire radiative power of the upwind detections

boundary_layer_m.description: Boundary layer height in metres. Below ~200 m indicates a collapsed inversion.

wind_from_bearing_deg.description: Direction the wind comes FROM, degrees clockwise from north

ratio_to_baseline.description: observed_pm25 divided by the trailing 14-day mean

recommended_actions.description: Who should act. Names a role or office, never a person and never a contact detail.

public_advisory.description: One plain sentence for residents, in English. Consumers translate for their own population.

predicted_pm25.description: OPTIONAL. Model-estimated PM2.5 in ug/m3, for publishers that run a gridded estimator.

station_idw_baseline.description: OPTIONAL. Inverse-distance-weighted estimate from surrounding stations in ug/m3.

residual_pm25.description: OPTIONAL. predicted_pm25 minus station_idw_baseline. Publish this only alongside evidence that the estimator beats the IDW baseline under leave-one-station-out validation; otherwise the residual is model error, not a discovered hotspot. Required in schema 1.0.0; optional since 2.0.0.
